summary: Blossom Tales 1.4.0 on Knulli Scarab (Anbernic RG CubeXX, H700): pad discovered and admitted, GPTK owner active with 11 sinks, context menu, MonoGame saw 'Xbox Wireless Controller', video/audio OK, no control and no SELECT+START answered. Receipt: NXC6-DOMAIN ... rewritten=1 rewritten_bindings=13 ... volume_markers=0 result=rewritten; NXC6-SEAM source_domain=joydev-legacy target_domain=sdl2-evdev.

device.ev_key_note: DTS (fdt_boot_package.fex_0.dts, image knulli-h700-rg-cubexx-gladiator-ii-20250813, sha256 87f886e0...) lists 0x72, 0x73 and 0x130..0x13c; es_input.cfg of the same image binds a=id3, so exactly THREE keys precede 0x130 in the ascending sweep (the tester's log reported 17 buttons). The third low code is not in the DTS; 0x11 is a placeholder < 0x72. Reproduction and fix do not depend on its value.

physical_table.trust_root: DTS gpio-keys-polled labels of the CubeXX image (tests/providers/provider-manifest-v5.json: knulli-cubexx-dts) + es_input.cfg sha256 9f31c56b...
